text:
alex: quick async roundup — short bullets

alex: what I did: tweaked microbatch slotting for kernel v2, landed a fix that reduces slot steal on long sequences. ran a 30m perf run against the canary pool. p50 down ~7ms, p95 down ~18ms. KV hit rate improved from 62% -> 74% on that workload. :tada:

alex: blockers: saw a recurrent OOM on shard-7 during compaction under sustained 1024 tokens. repro script attached below. sounds like KV compaction + large batch > memory threshold.

alex: repro (quick):
```
# repro loop
for i in {1..300}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://canary:8443/generate -d '{"input":"A long sequence ...","max_tokens":1024}' | jq . > /dev/null
  sleep 0.5
done
```

alex: plan: add a soft cap on compaction concurrency and add a pre-check in the runtime to split >512 token batches into smaller windows. will open PR tonight.

jamie: saw the same OOM yesterday on shard-3, thanks for the repro. I have a half-finished patch that throttles compaction workers — will sync with your PR and push tests. cc @alex

pat: bench numbers look great. do we have end-to-end traces for the canary run? curious where the extra 18ms came off.

alex: got traces — attaching a short excerpt below (top spans):
```
kernel.exec  p50: 12ms p95: 46ms
kv.lookup   p50: 3ms  p95: 12ms
caching     p50: 1ms  p95: 5ms
network     p50: 4ms  p95: 9ms
```

alex: looks like kernel.exec improved due to fewer slot steals; KV lookup improved from better locality. network unchanged.

sophia: tiny ask — can we add a perf-eval that runs the 1024 token trace overnight in CI for dedicated? catches regressions earlier. (I can wire it into Optimize job)

alex: yes please — that would have flagged this earlier. sophia, if you add the job, I can add the gating alert to rollout policy.

infra-bot: deploy: canary-pool/v2 -> succeeded (2024-11-14T21:15:32Z) :rocket:

jamie: quick note on reviews: PR #4312 (compaction throttle) is ready for review, small diff, unit tests added. pinged eng-runtime-owners.

pat: will take a look after standup. if it's small we can merge and run extended canary. :+1:

sophia: also adding a KV hit-rate dashboard panel to the runtime overview so we can correlate with latency — will post link when done.

alex: thanks all — no blocker for rollout once compaction throttle lands. if anyone sees a new OOM after merge, ping here and tag shard id. :eyes:
